subject: if-st-dy
title: IF.ST.DY.------C.CONT.
description: Diagram in PCC-22. (C)IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) is crossed with C-CONT (composite continuance): the question is what infrastructure dynamics looks like when crossed with composite continuance. IF-ST-DY → C-CONT (the crossing). STF (source transfer) and CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis) branch from the main line. Two lines branch from CULT-AF-BS. One runs to INFO-DY (information dynamics), from which POST (postulation) branches. The other runs to MT-DEVF (multiple diversification), which branches to (R)MTH (the reality of methodology), with IST-F (isolated focus) branching from (R)MTH, and to SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics), from which LANG-DY (language dynamics) branches.
